LATAM
*chunk4*
```{r}
# Load the data frames from the RDS file
data_latam <- readRDS("Data/Input/updated_modern_dataset_climate_hill.rds") |>
  select(-c(mapr, mi, gdd0, mat, mtco, mtwa, alpha, age_bp))

data_latam

#Remover taxa con valores de cero
modern_pollen_latam <- data_latam |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(id_sample:entity_type),names_to = "taxa") |>
  filter(value > 0)

#Remover taxa que ocurren en menos del 1 % de las muestas
n_total <- n_distinct(modern_pollen_latam$id_sample)

aux1 <- modern_pollen_latam |>
  group_by(taxa) |>
  mutate(n_samples = n_distinct(id_sample)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(n_samples >= 0.002 * n_total) |>
  select(-n_samples)

#Funcion para manejar casos donde todos en el grupo son NAs
mode_na <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  names(sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
}

modern_pollen_latam <- aux1 |>
  group_by(id_sample) |>
  mutate(value = value / sum(value)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(taxa) |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(id_sample:entity_type),
    names_from = "taxa",
    values_fill = 0
  ) |>
  select(-c(id_sample, entity_name)) |>
  group_by(latitude, longitude) |>
  summarise(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    site_type = mode_na(site_type),
    entity_type = mode_na(entity_type),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(id_sample = paste0("ID_", row_number())) |>
  select(id_sample, everything())


modern_pollen_latam <- modern_pollen_latam |>
  select(id_sample:elevation, site_type, entity_type, everything()) |>
  select(-site_type, -entity_type)
  
modern_pollen_latam
```

```{r}
# EPSG:6933 se usa como cuadrícula global equivalente para el raster.
# No se usará para calcular distancias.

r_trp_equalarea <- terra::project(r_trp, crs_equal_area, method = "bilinear")

#crs(r_trp_equalarea)

land_latam_vect <- terra::vect(land_polyg_latam)
land_eur_vect   <- terra::vect(land_polyg_eur)
land_afr_vect   <- terra::vect(land_polyg_afr)

land_latam_equalarea <- terra::project(land_latam_vect, crs_equal_area)
land_eur_equalarea   <- terra::project(land_eur_vect, crs_equal_area)
land_afr_equalarea   <- terra::project(land_afr_vect, crs_equal_area)
```

*chunk18*
```{r}
# CHUNK 18 — extraer celdas candidatas con buffers locales
candidate_radius_km <- 51

extract_candidates_local <- function(r, pts, candidate_radius_km) {

  raster_crs_sf <- sf::st_crs(terra::crs(r))

  purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(pts)), function(i) {

    lon <- pts$longitude[i]
    lat <- pts$latitude[i]

    # Proyección equidistante centrada en este sitio
    crs_local <- sprintf(paste("+proj=aeqd +lat_0=%.8f +lon_0=%.8f",
                               "+datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs +type=crs"), lat, lon)

    buffer_raster_crs <- sf::st_sfc(sf::st_point(c(lon, lat)),crs = 4326) |>
      sf::st_transform(crs_local) |>
      sf::st_buffer(dist = candidate_radius_km * 1000, nQuadSegs = 90) |>
      sf::st_transform(raster_crs_sf)

    extracted <- terra::extract(r, terra::vect(buffer_raster_crs),
                                cells = TRUE, xy = TRUE, touches = TRUE)

    if (nrow(extracted) == 0) {
      return(tibble::tibble())
    }

    tibble::as_tibble(extracted) |>
      dplyr::mutate(ID = i)
  })
}

extract_candidates_latam <- extract_candidates_local(r = r_latam,
                                                     pts = pts_latam,
                                                     candidate_radius_km = candidate_radius_km)

extract_candidates_europa <- extract_candidates_local(r = r_europa,
                                                      pts = pts_europa,
                                                      candidate_radius_km = candidate_radius_km)
```



*chunk19*
```{r}
# CHUNK 19 — calcular distancias geodésicas en km
add_geodesic_distance <- function(extracted, pts, r, candidate_radius_km) {

  point_lookup <- tibble::tibble(ID = seq_len(nrow(pts)),
                                 site_lon = pts$longitude,
                                 site_lat = pts$latitude)

  extracted |>
    dplyr::left_join(point_lookup, by = "ID") |>
    dplyr::group_by(ID) |>
    dplyr::group_modify(function(.x, .y) {

      cell_points <- terra::vect(.x, geom = c("x", "y"), crs = terra::crs(r))
      cell_wgs84 <- terra::project(cell_points, "EPSG:4326")
      cell_lonlat <- terra::crds(cell_wgs84)
      distances_km <- geosphere::distGeo(p1 = c(.x$site_lon[1], .x$site_lat[1]),
                                         p2 = cell_lonlat) / 1000

      .x |>
        dplyr::mutate(distance_km = distances_km) |>
        dplyr::filter(distance_km <= candidate_radius_km)
    }) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::select(-site_lon, -site_lat)
}


extract_geod_latam <- add_geodesic_distance(extracted = extract_candidates_latam,
                                            pts = pts_latam,
                                            r = r_latam,
                                            candidate_radius_km = candidate_radius_km)

extract_geod_europa <- add_geodesic_distance(extracted = extract_candidates_europa,
                                             pts = pts_europa,
                                             r = r_europa,
                                            candidate_radius_km = candidate_radius_km)
```

```{r}
# CHUNK 20 — comprobar extracciones y distancias

check_extraction <- function(data, pts, region) {
  tibble::tibble(
    region = region,
    sites_expected = nrow(pts),
    sites_extracted = dplyr::n_distinct(data$ID),
    pixels_extracted = nrow(data),
    min_distance_km = min(data$distance_km, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_distance_km = median(data$distance_km, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_distance_km = max(data$distance_km, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

dplyr::bind_rows(check_extraction(extract_geod_latam, pts_latam, "LATAM"),
                 check_extraction(extract_geod_europa, pts_europa, "Europa"))
```

```{r}
# CHUNK 26 — calcular resúmenes gaussianos por sitio y escenario
max_radius_km <- max(scenarios$radius_km)

# Reducir las tablas en memoria al radio máximo de los escenarios actuales
extract_current_latam <- extract_geod_latam |> dplyr::filter(distance_km <= max_radius_km)

rm(extract_geod_latam)

extract_current_europa <- extract_geod_europa |>
  dplyr::filter(distance_km <= max_radius_km)

rm(extract_geod_europa)
gc()

# Calcular media y mediana ponderadas para un sitio
summarise_gaussian_site <- function(data, sigma_km) {

  valid <- !is.na(data$tree_cover)

  if (!any(valid) || mean(!valid) > 0.5) {
    return(tibble::tibble(tree_mean = NA_real_, tree_median = NA_real_ ))
  }

  values <- data$tree_cover[valid]

  weights <- exp(-0.5 * (data$distance_km[valid] / sigma_km)^2)

  tibble::tibble(tree_mean = sum(values * weights) / sum(weights),
                 tree_median = matrixStats::weightedMedian(x = values, w = weights))
}


# Aplicar todos los escenarios a una región
calculate_gaussian_scenarios <- function(extracted, scenarios) {

  purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(scenarios)), function(i) {

    radius_i <- scenarios$radius_km[i]
    sigma_i  <- scenarios$sigma_km[i]

    extracted |>
      dplyr::filter(distance_km <= radius_i) |>
      dplyr::group_by(ID) |>
      dplyr::group_modify(~ summarise_gaussian_site(.x, sigma_km = sigma_i)) |>
      dplyr::ungroup() |>
      dplyr::mutate(scenario = scenarios$scenario[i])
  })
}


results_latam_long <- calculate_gaussian_scenarios(extracted = extract_current_latam,
                                                   scenarios = scenarios)

results_europa_long <- calculate_gaussian_scenarios(extracted = extract_current_europa,
                                                    scenarios = scenarios)
```




*chunk27*
```{r}
# CHUNK 27 — pasar a formato ancho y unir a las tablas de polen

id_lookup_latam <- tibble::tibble(ID = seq_len(nrow(pts_latam)),
                                  id_sample = pts_latam$id_sample)

id_lookup_europa <- tibble::tibble(ID = seq_len(nrow(pts_europa)),
                                   id_sample = pts_europa$id_sample)


tree_gaussian_latam_wide <- results_latam_long |>
  dplyr::left_join(id_lookup_latam, by = "ID") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = c(ID, id_sample),
                     names_from = scenario,
                     values_from = c(tree_mean, tree_median),
                     names_glue = "{.value}_{scenario}")

tree_gaussian_europa_wide <- results_europa_long |>
  dplyr::left_join(id_lookup_europa, by = "ID") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = c(ID, id_sample),
                     names_from = scenario,
                     values_from = c(tree_mean, tree_median),
                     names_glue = "{.value}_{scenario}")


modern_pollen_latam_gaussian <- modern_pollen_latam |>
  dplyr::left_join(tree_gaussian_latam_wide |> dplyr::select(-ID),
                   by = "id_sample")

modern_pollen_europa_gaussian <- modern_pollen_europe |>
  dplyr::left_join(tree_gaussian_europa_wide |> dplyr::select(-ID), by = "id_sample")


dim(modern_pollen_latam_gaussian)
dim(modern_pollen_europa_gaussian)
```




```{r}
ggplot(data = modern_pollen_europa_gaussian) +
  geom_point(aes(x=longitude, y=latitude, colour = tree_median_25km)) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma")

ggplot(data = modern_pollen_europa_gaussian) +
  geom_point(aes(x=longitude, y=latitude, colour = tree_median_1.5km)) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma")
```


```{r}
# CHUNK 28 — validar y guardar las tablas finales

expected_columns <- c(paste0("tree_mean_", scenarios$scenario),
  paste0("tree_median_", scenarios$scenario))

stopifnot(nrow(modern_pollen_latam_gaussian) == nrow(modern_pollen_latam),
          nrow(modern_pollen_europa_gaussian) == nrow(modern_pollen_europe),
          all(expected_columns %in% names(modern_pollen_latam_gaussian)),
          all(expected_columns %in% names(modern_pollen_europa_gaussian)))

# Número de estimaciones no faltantes por columna
check_estimates <- function(data, region) {
  data |>
    dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(expected_columns), ~ sum(!is.na(.x)))) |>
    dplyr::mutate(region = region, .before = 1)
}


dplyr::bind_rows(check_estimates(modern_pollen_latam_gaussian, "LATAM"), 
                 check_estimates(modern_pollen_europa_gaussian, "Europa"))

```

```{r}
saveRDS(modern_pollen_europa_gaussian,
  "Data/Bastin_Forest_potential_tree_cover/extraction_points/modern_pollen_EUROPA_gaussian_geodesic.rds")
```
